instructions: Unpack the archive named ffmpeg-*.tar.gz and checkout every source tree at the revision shown in the table. Unpack btbn-build-*.tar.gz; it contains the variants, scripts and patches used for this release.

The release was produced with the builder's linux64 GPL variant. Generate the stage Dockerfile with the builder's generate.sh for linux64 and gpl, apply the patches directory, and run the stages in the order that file records. The configure options are listed above; build.sh adds the cross compiler, arch, prefix and extra-version flags.
Build the executable and compare its SHA-256 with the shipped executable. The distribution only uses a byte-identical result.
